_comment: Higgs Audio V3 via TTS-Audio-Suite. The house voice engine: it produced the most natural, character-ful reads of every engine tested. Cast a character by pointing node 30's narrator_voice at a reference clip - never by pitch-shifting one voice, which is what made the first films sound like a single actor on a varispeed tape.
_notes: Higgs V3 works where Higgs V2 does not - use the V3 node.
No emotion control here; that is IndexTTS-2 (workflow 16). Use this for narration and most dialogue, and 16 for lines that need a directed performance.
Do NOT cast the Clint_Eastwood / David_Attenborough / Morgan_Freeman / Sophie_Anderson clips that ship with the pack - clones of real identifiable people.
A new reference voice needs a companion .reference.txt (transcribe it with the suite's Granite ASR) and a ComfyUI restart before it appears.
